list: The quarterly business meeting will be held following the morning worship service.
Women on Mission will meet Monday, September 14 in the Lewis Fellowship Hall at 6:00 PM. Anna Collins will present the program, and Linda Baker will provide the food.
The last Beech Creek Round Up for Christ of the year is Wednesday, September 30.

fighterVerse.text: 6 … He who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and he who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully. 7 So let each one give as he purposes in his heart, not grudgingly or of necessity; for God loves a cheerful giver.
